authority_invariant: The member runtime makes registered Penta systems addressable and operable. It recognizes only exact-evidence-bound maturity promotions from the separate promotion registry and never manufactures authority, provider state, credentials, or provider effects.
execution_boundary: All member adapters are repository-local and provider-effect false. PentaEVIBuilder emits an unverified preview; PentaImmune emits a bounded plan without executing repair; PentaContext reports fixed local contract hashes without contacting its provider or accepting credentials; PentaMail reports historical evidence without evaluating current provider state; PentaCredentials returns no secret values; PentaBuild writes only disposable local artifacts; PentaCertify disables network probes. No local adapter promotes provider state or production.
promotion_rule: A member advances only through a PASS record with matching prior catalog maturity, external authority reference, exact evidence digests, existing runtime paths, and a tested bounded adapter. Provider-effect operations remain separately authorized, credential-bound, certified, readback-gated, and HOLD-aware.
